body: BLOCK on exact 2913397, two source-proven type holes. (1) Conditional is a case class, so the claim that it has no unconditional accessor is false: generated Product accessors expose the payload as Conditional(...)._1 and productElement(0), and unapply permits extraction. javap on the exact compiled class shows public _1 and productElement. The compile-time tripwire checks only .value and .get, so it misses the actual escape hatch. This violates ADR 0003's canonical value-plus-support rule and makes valueIgnoringResolution's deliberately visible name optional. Minimal repair: make Conditional a final non-case class with private constructor/underlying, public resolution, whenResolved, explicitly named escape hatch and map; no Product/unapply; add compile-time negatives for _1/productElement. (2) PlacementResolution.complete constructs directly with a caller-supplied threshold, bypassing of: complete(Detail, Double.NaN) and complete(Detail, -1.0) create invalid public states despite the smart-constructor contract. Minimal repair: remove the threshold parameter from total complete, or return Either/delegate through validated construction, with NaN/out-of-range regressions. Excluded mass is the right third component: policy removal is neither resolved evidence nor model abstention. Grain also belongs. I would ACCEPT the shape after these two holes close; downstream producers still need ADR 0003 production-path, reducer, and definition-identity evidence before this vehicle proves any estimand fixed.
